Class BaseCtl<F extends BaseForm,T extends BaseDTO,S extends BaseServiceInt<T>>

java.lang.Object

Type Parameters:
F -
T -
S -
Direct Known Subclasses:
CollegeCtl, CompanyCtl, CourseCtl, DocumentCtl, FacultyCtl, LoginCtl, MarksheetCtl, MessageCtl, PlacementCtl, RoleCtl, StudentCtl, SubjectCtl, UserCtl
public abstract class BaseCtl<F extends BaseForm,T extends BaseDTO,S extends BaseServiceInt<T>> extends Object
Base controller class contains get, search, save, delete REST APIs

Endpoints exposed by every subclass (relative to its own @RequestMapping):

  • GET /info - health check
  • GET / - list all entities
  • GET /{id} - get entity by ID
  • GET|POST /search - search entities by form attributes, paginated
  • GET|POST /search/{pageNo} - search entities by form attributes, page size 5
  • POST / - add entity, or update it when the form carries an existing ID
  • PUT /{id} - replace entity identified by ID
  • PATCH /{id} - partially update entity fields identified by ID
  • DELETE /{id} - delete entity by ID

    • setUserContext

      @ModelAttribute public void setUserContext(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
      Resolves the UserContext for the current request. For protected endpoints, FrontCtl has already validated the JWT Bearer token and stored the resolved loginId in request attribute "loginId" before this runs. Public endpoints (e.g. /auth/login) never reach the interceptor, so they fall through to a default, org-less context.
